data.location: Seminole and Orange counties (Address not specified)
data.short_description: Scrape Yuh Plate, a Jamaican cuisine food truck from Rajiv Graham and Nastasia Reid, is preparing to serve Seminole and Orange counties. The mobile food truck will offer dishes like oxtail, curry goat, jerk chicken, and roti.

data.location: 4900 S. University Drive, Suite 205, Davie, FL 33328
data.status: targeting an end of June opening
data.short_description: Golf Vault, a new golf simulator lounge from Chris Flores and Gil Martin, will open above Pinza 104 in Davie. The 4,000-square-foot venue will offer simulators, lounge seating, food from Pinza 104, and event space.

The Artist's Realm, owned by Kaitlyn Merryman, will offer art, music and photography lessons for all ages. The space will open in phases, beginning with traditional art classes including painting, drawing and sculpture.

Kingston 10 Jerk Center & Lounge, from Shericka Daley and Ann Marie Bailey, will offer authentic Jamaican food and entertainment in the former Baked Chicken location. The restaurant will seat about 85 across two dining rooms and a patio.

data.location: 7700 N. Wickham Road, Suite 101, Melbourne, FL 32940
data.short_description: Pepe's Cantina is a full-service Mexican restaurant opening in the former Mi Jalisco space with seating for about 150 guests. The Melbourne location will feature a relaxed atmosphere with plants and music.

Mitch's Downtown Bagel Cafe is planning its fifth location and first Miami-Dade restaurant in Coral Gables. The elevated New York-style bagel shop and deli will have about 28 seats inside and 16 seats outside.

Willy Buck's Backyard Grill, owned by Michael Brown, will open its first brick-and-mortar location in the former Dairy Ranch space. The smash burger and barbecue concept will offer counter ordering, kiosks, and 30-40 seats.

Boost Coffee & Energy is opening its first location in Jacksonville with founder Joe Herlihy and Mike Murray. The drive-thru concept will roast beans in-house at each location and offer customizable drinks, an order-ahead app, and a walk-up window.

data.status: targeting a November opening, pending construction
data.short_description: Cousin Vinny's Sandwich Co. is opening a second location in St. Petersburg with Chef Vinny Andriotti and co-owners. The quick-service shop offers Northeast-style sandwiches with indoor and outdoor patio seating.

data.location: 2079 Joseph E Boone Blvd NW Atlanta, GA 30314
data.event_date: End of May or early June
data.short_description: Black Pizza is a new, black-owned pizzeria opening in Bankhead. Founders Sela Afeworki and Natnael Tekeste are behind the family-friendly project along with additional partners.
Botanico Hospitality Group is planning a new concept in Midtown Atlanta. Partner Felipe Rivera confirmed the details.

data.location: 1025 Howell Mill Rd NW, Atlanta, GA 30318
data.short_description: Incognito is a new Botanico Hospitality Group concept planned for West Midtown Atlanta. Partner Felipe Rivera confirmed the details.
Knuckies Sandwiches and Sips is planned for the Medley development in Johns Creek. The opening is planned in step with the broader Medley development opening at 10 a.m.

data.location: 11650 Johns Creek Pkwy, Johns Creek, GA 30097
data.short_description: The Nest Cafe is planning to open its third metro Atlanta location in the Medley development. A grand opening is planned across the entire development at 10 a.m.
Trap Wingz is opening two new locations in Atlanta, founder Damico Green shared. Details on the first location to open were referenced in the round-up.

data.status: Targeting a late summer or early fall opening; construction preparations are underway
data.short_description: Churp is a streamlined healthy bowl concept from the founder of Happy + Hale, focused on affordability and clean ingredients. The menu features rice bowls with chicken, vegetables, sauces, and kids meals without seed oils.
Topsail Steamer is a Shark Tank-featured take-home seafood boil concept coming to Raleigh. Customers can build seafood boil buckets in-store or order online for pickup.
Mikey's Pizzeria is a counter-service pizza spot with indoor and patio seating, plus build-your-own pizza experiences. Guests will find beer, wine, and arcade-style games.
Fatbackzz Grill is opening its first brick-and-mortar location inside Sam's Mini Mart in Graham. The Fatbackzz food truck will continue operating alongside the new restaurant.
Halftime Hangout Sports Bar is preparing to open in Raeford with a family-and-friends event planned on the 15th. An official opening date is to be announced.

data.location: 282 S Sharon Amity Rd, Suite 104 and 106B, Charlotte, NC 28211
data.short_description: Kitchen Social is planning to open in Cotswold Village in Charlotte. The restaurant will be similar to its Sarasota location, with indoor-outdoor dining, a covered patio, and an indoor-outdoor bar.
Sonrisa, a Latin American restaurant and bar, is now open in Charlotte. The menu draws from Latin American, Caribbean, South American and Central American cuisines.

data.location: Raleigh, NC (Address not specified in this excerpt)
data.short_description: A new concept from the co-founder of Happy and Hale is in the works in Wake County. Churp is a bowl concept focused on simplicity.

data.status: waiting on a final state inspection and targeting an opening
data.short_description: Rose's Coffee & Cones is a small coffee and ice cream shop in a historic cottage-style building in Ybor City. Menu highlights include paninis, specialty coffees, Turkish ice cream and Italian gelato.

data.store_name: Smokin Oak Wood Fired Pizza & Taproom
data.short_description: Smokin Oak Wood Fired Pizza & Taproom is preparing to open in Lithia based on a February 11 interview with co-owner Lauren Hoger. Details from the article are limited in the excerpt.

Churp is a new clean-eating bowl concept from Tyler Helikson, CEO and co-founder of Happy and Hale. The streamlined menu features rice bowls with chicken, fresh vegetables, sauces, and a kids menu without seed oils or ultra-processed food.
Tiny Kitchen is opening with owner Alejandro Veiga, his wife Samantha Skarl, and Chef Marta Veiga. The 680-square-foot space will serve Argentinian street food near Fifth Avenue South.

data.event_date: End of June or first week of July
data.short_description: Will Morin and Kent Simmons are bringing Lenny's Grill & Subs back to Pensacola with their first franchise location. The restaurant is targeting a summer opening.

data.location: 300 W. Tyler St., Suite A, Tampa, FL 33602
data.short_description: Matilde Coastal Mexican Kitchen is coming to the AER Tampa building in downtown Tampa. Next Level Brands founder Jeff Gigante confirmed the timeline.
Crooked Can Brewing Company is planning a destination brewery and venue for its fourth location. The team is hoping to open during the third week of June, though the date remains a moving target.
Bro's Hot Chicken is preparing to open its third location in Sweetwater. The opening marks a long-awaited expansion for the Miami-born Nashville hot chicken brand.

Mikey's Pizzeria, from owner Michael Longo, is taking over the former Pizza and Pints location in Raleigh. The 2,700-square-foot space will offer counter service, pizza by the slice, build-your-own pizza, beer and wine, and arcade games.

Halftime Hangout Sports Bar, co-owned by Brigida Amos, is opening as a neighborhood spot for sports, food, and drinks with a pool table and dart boards. The menu starts with sports bar fare and will add Louisiana dishes like gumbo and po'boys.

data.location: 2259 Dr. Randy McDaniel Way, Middleton, FL 34762
data.short_description: Piesanos Stone Fired Pizza is planning its 16th location in Middleton, a new build with about 150 seats and a patio facing a splash pad. The restaurant will offer full-service dining, a full bar, and an Express To-Go area.

data.status: working through permitting and construction plans
data.short_description: Topsail Steamer, a Shark Tank-featured take-home seafood boil concept, is coming to Raleigh through franchisee sisters Renee Moore and Paige Rogalski. Customers can order online for pickup or build buckets in-store with fresh seafood and fixings.

Fatbackzz Grill is opening its first brick-and-mortar location inside Sam's Mini Mart in Graham. The restaurant will serve breakfast, lunch, dinner and late-night comfort food including cheesesteaks, hibachi, burgers and wings.

data.location: 282 S Sharon Amity Rd, Suite 104 and 106B, Charlotte, NC 28211
data.short_description: Kitchen Social, an Ohio-based brand, is planning to open in Cotswold Village in Charlotte. The space will be about 4,200 square feet and seat about 165 guests with indoor-outdoor dining, a covered patio and an indoor-outdoor bar. The scratch-made menu has about 35 items with Indian, Asian, Mexican and Italian influences.

Botanico Hospitality Group is bringing back the Botanico brand to Midtown Atlanta, taking over the former Lure space which is currently undergoing remodeling. The upscale Latin concept will have around 150 seats and serve cuisine inspired by Colombia, Venezuela, Mexico, Peru, Cuba and the Caribbean.

data.location: 1025 Howell Mill Rd NW, Atlanta, GA 30318
data.short_description: Incognito is a cocktail bar described as a modern, chic dive bar with elevated mixology in West Midtown. The bar will include pool tables, banquet seating, a DJ, outdoor picnic tables and several screens, with food provided through a truck from El Santo Gallo.

data.status: opening planned for October 29th at 10 a.m.
data.short_description: Knuckies Sandwiches and Sips is opening as the 10th location of the brand at the Medley development. The roughly 1,100-square-foot restaurant will be a more elevated version of the brand with a chef-driven sandwich menu and a dirty soda component called Sparkraft.

data.location: 4725 S Atlanta Rd SE, Atlanta, GA 30339
data.status: expected to open in the next 60-70 days
data.short_description: Trap Wingz is opening its third location in Atlanta in a strip development that previously housed Bites. The concept, founded in 2018, is known for decadent combos featuring crispy wings, burgers, fried fish, Philly cheesesteaks and fries, specializing in take out and online ordering.

data.status: expected to open in the next 60-90 days
data.short_description: Trap Wingz is opening its fourth location in Atlanta. The brand specializes in take out with crispy wings, burgers, fried fish, Philly cheesesteaks and fries, available via online ordering through DoorDash, GrubHub and more.

data.short_description: Black Pizza is a new black-owned, family-friendly pizzeria opening in Bankhead with dining room occupancy for up to 65 guests. The shop will specialize in New York-style slices and full pies, with menu items including specialty pizzas, wings, fries and family-sized combo specials.

Hawaiian Bros, a plate lunch concept, is planned as franchisee MRCO's first location for the brand. The menu serves rice, chicken and a side, including huli huli chicken with sides such as steamed vegetables and macaroni salad, with no fryers, microwaves or freezers used.

data.location: 675 W Peachtree St NE, Atlanta, GA 30308
data.short_description: Pour Intentions Wine Bar is a wine-focused lounge built around storytelling and curated experiences near the Fox Theatre. Menu highlights include charcuterie boards, small plates, desserts, and a rotating by-the-glass wine list from boutique and sustainable vineyards.

data.status: Targeting late May opening, pending final approvals
data.short_description: V's Coffee Collab is a compact, community-driven coffee shop designed for conversation over laptop work, with limited indoor seating and a service window. The menu features house-roasted coffee, pastries from local vendors, and rotating retail coffee bags featuring artwork from local creatives.

data.event_date: late May; may shift into June
data.status: Aiming for late May; may shift into June depending on construction and permits
data.short_description: Juice Time is a dessert and beverage spot blending indulgent treats with lighter options, including Middle Eastern desserts not widely available locally. Menu highlights include fresh juices, smoothies, protein shakes, crepes and ice cream.

data.location: 3067 NE 163rd Road, North Miami Beach, FL 33160
data.status: targeting an opening by the beginning of June
data.short_description: Maestro Italian Bakery will focus on Italian baked goods made with selected ingredients, including organic, non-GMO flour from a small mill in northern Italy. The small space will have about 12 to 16 seats inside with offerings including pasticcini, cookies, croissants, bomboloni, breads, pizza, focaccia and paninis.

Kook's Conch Fritters is a female veteran-owned pop-up serving South Florida, with its first event appearance at Juneteenth South Broward on June 20 at Washington Park in Hollywood. The menu features conch fritter bites, conch salad and conch fritter batter for at-home frying, built around a family recipe.

data.location: 1400 10th St Unit D, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
data.short_description: Baisel's African Restaurant is the first restaurant from owners Godfred and Faustina Baisel, focused on Ghanaian and West African cuisine. The space will start with about 14 seats and serve dishes including egusi, fufu, banku, okra soup, jollof rice and grilled tilapia.

data.event_date: end of June or first week of July
data.status: targeting an end of June or first week of July opening
data.short_description: Lenny's Grill & Subs is returning to Pensacola with its first franchise location for the brand in a renovated downtown building. The neighborhood sub shop focuses on fresh-sliced meats, cheesesteaks, hot subs, cold subs, salads and wraps, with a pickup window, digital kiosk and counter service.

data.location: 12741 Yellow Bluff Rd., Suites 1 and 2, Jacksonville, FL 32226
data.status: targeting an early to mid-August opening
data.short_description: Southern Smokehouse will be South Atlantic Hospitality's first barbecue concept and second restaurant. The full-service restaurant will have 120 seats and a full-service liquor bar, with traditional barbecue items along with salads, handheld items, signature sauces, barbecue lasagna and a turkey leg.

Blackberry Creamery & Cafe is an ice cream-focused concept anchored within a larger outdoor food truck park with seating, pergola space and multiple vendors. Menu highlights include butter pecan bourbon and blackberry bliss ice cream flavors, milkshakes, shaved ice and fresh lemonades.

Supra Revolving Sushi Bar is a full-service restaurant with a conveyor belt sushi system and a large dining room built for both casual meals and groups. The menu includes sushi, hibachi, ramen, appetizers, milk tea and alcoholic beverages.

data.location: 12553 Bartram Park Blvd., Suite 302, Jacksonville, FL 32258
data.short_description: Lucky Goat Coffee is a fast-casual coffee shop with indoor seating and a small patio, focused on approachable specialty coffee and quick ordering. The menu features espresso drinks, cold brew, nitro, seasonal lattes, signature drinks like the Lucky Bomb, and pastries sourced from local bakery partners.

Big Bone BBQ will bring Texas-style barbecue to Pensacola, operating as a self-serve concept inside a historic 1918 home with six tables and a five-seat bar. The menu centers on dino beef ribs, brisket, smoked braised beef cheeks, armadillo eggs, and housemade sides and sauces.

Donatos Pizza, a family-owned brand based in Columbus, Ohio, is opening one of its first Florida locations in Panama City. The fast-casual restaurant will have nine seats, a pickup window and delivery service, with a menu featuring thin crust party-cut pizza, subs, salads and wings.
